description: Database view exposing complaint dashboard complaint details data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report complaint dashboard complaint details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Customer Support area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the complaint dashboard complaint details view.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: regionid
columns.description: Regionid of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: areaid
columns.description: Areaid of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: product_name_type
columns.description: Product name type of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: nature_of_complaint
columns.description: Nature of complaint of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: qty_on_claim
columns.description: Qty on claim of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: dealerid
columns.description: Dealerid of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: dispatch_qty
columns.description: Dispatch qty of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

columns.name: percentage
columns.description: Percentage of the complaint dashboard complaint details.

business_rules: created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use qty_on_claim / dispatch_qty for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns product_name_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Vw_ComplaintDashboardComplaintDetails is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Complaint Dashboard Complaint Details by month
Complaint Dashboard Complaint Details count by product name type
Total qty on claim by month

known_issues: dispatch_qty, percentage are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_ComplaintDashboardComplaintDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(qty_on_claim) for totals of qty on claim.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
